verdict.rationale: Jan's own Cloud Integration lets users connect to remotely hosted models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax and others instead of downloading them, and the docs say users can switch freely between local and frontier models. That covers running models without local hardware. However, these are third-party providers rather than a Jan-hosted cloud tier, and nothing documents offloading the same large open models a user would otherwise run locally. missing for 10: first-party hosted cloud tier, documented offload of specific large/open models when local hardware is insufficient, hardware-aware fallback guidance, independent hands-on corroboration
